# Incident and Disclosure Policy — TEMPLATE

## Scope of reportable events

- Security incidents affecting any project-controlled infrastructure, wallet, or repository
- Material changes to token supply, distribution, or issuer configuration
- Discovery that project materials (website, whitepaper, GitHub) misstate implementation status
- Custody failures, key compromise, or loss of access
- Material changes to team, ownership, or control
